Sell more with unlimited product reviews, UGC, star ratings, Google reviews and testimonials

Driving traffic is only half the battle – trust is what converts. Judge.me boosts conversion rate with unlimited product reviews, star ratings, and UGC (photo/video). Automate review requests after fulfillment or delivery, launch review widgets and testimonial sliders, boost visibility with Google reviews & SEO page. Share reviews and star ratings on Meta & TikTok, import Etsy & Amazon reviews and drive repeat purchases with coupons & referrals. Fully customizable, 24/7 support.

What merchants think

This is generated by Shopify Magic. It's shown when an app has 100+ reviews and at least a 4.0 overall rating.

Feedback submitted

Merchants describe this as an easy-to-use, reliable review app with strong value, especially for small and growing stores. Setup is quick, widgets are professional, customizable, and mobile-friendly, and photo reviews help boost conversions. Merchants like the useful free plan, smooth importing, SEO benefits (rich snippets, Google Shopping), and integrations with tools like Klaviyo and Gorgias. Support is frequently praised as fast, hands-on, and available 24/7.

I'm new to Shopify, and before starting out I had very little idea of how to set up and manage customer reviews. There's actually a lot more to it than I initially realised, but Judge.me has been a fantastic addition to my website.

Recently, I encountered what appeared to be an issue with displaying replies to customer reviews. I raised the issue through the app's support chat and was really impressed by how quickly they responded. The problem was identified and resolved within minutes.

So far, my experience with Judge.me has been excellent. It's a great app, backed by genuinely responsive and helpful support. Highly recommended!
